name: ibis budget Singapore Pearl
short_description: A 2-star, 129-room ecocertified budget hotel on Lorong 14 Geylang, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT and 15 minutes' drive from Orchard Road.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Pearl sits at 21 Lorong 14 Geylang -- formerly branded Fragrance Hotel - Pearl -- in the heart of Geylang's affordable dining scene, about a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station, 15 minutes' drive from Orchard Road, and 10 minutes' drive from the Suntec Convention Centre. The ecocertified economy hotel has 129 rooms across seven room types (12-18 sqm, 2-4 guests), free WiFi, and free parking. Its own Accor listing shows a strong 4.6/5 guest rating from 43 reviews, and Expedia lists a 7.6/10 score from over 2,200 reviews, with guests consistently praising helpful front-desk staff and the abundance of nearby food stalls and 24-hour convenience stores, alongside occasional complaints about hot water and the Geylang red-light-district setting. A confirmed December 2023 YouTube full-review video corroborates the budget-friendly, no-frills experience. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme's points or elite-tier benefits.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Pearl part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: How far is ibis budget Singapore Pearl from Orchard Road?
faqs.answer: It's about a 15-minute drive from Orchard Road, with the Suntec Convention Centre roughly 10 minutes away and the Central Business District about 15 minutes by car. Locally, it's a 10-minute walk from Aljunied MRT Station, surrounded by Geylang's hawker centres and 24-hour convenience stores.
